provenance.author: dnd-diceroll project agents (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5) for the repository owner
provenance.license: Project-owned original work; same terms as this repository
provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender 5.2.3 LTS from the r002 world kits (diorama crops) and procedural geometry and textures (table); no third-party, kit, AI-service or downloaded content

recipe.method: Authored from scratch by script: a deep war table (planks at 256 texels/m, 3.4 x 2.65 m) with a bookcase of leather spines behind it, a hand-drawn vellum map of the five-stop route held by stone weights with five glowing route markers, a candlestick, a pillar candle and a candle cluster (vertex-alpha flame glow), a tankard, dagger, dice, coins, pouch, inkwell and quill, scrolls and an hourglass; conforming subdivision (3.5 cm near props), ray-cast ambient occlusion and a warm candle bake
recipe.approved_reference: #138 look (candlelit tabletop overview); #149 lead calls; the r002 standard of #145, the Root and the Vault

parameters.pivot: middle of the table top; the table occupies x -0.60 to +2.05 (front toward +X) and y +-1.70

settings.importer: Interchange glTF via Content/Python/import_dark_fantasy_theme.py, explicit reviewed import (#149 overview set)
settings.material: MI_* child of M_DiceRollTheme: texture x COLOR_0.rgb, glow from COLOR_0.a
settings.texture_filter: trilinear with anisotropic 8, mips generated, never nearest
settings.texture_compression: default (sRGB, mips); no nearest or editor-icon compression
settings.lods: none: one low-count mesh drawn by the overview only (the table is placed once, the dioramas at most twice)
settings.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 VEC4 normalised uint16 (RGB baked light, A glow mask: flames and route markers)
settings.axes: metres, the asset faces +X (the overview turns it -90 degrees about Z toward the camera), +Y is the viewer's right, Z up (glTF Y-up export)
